composition: Full-viewport WebGL stage as the layout. Headline and meta sit as thin HUD overlays at edges rather than a stacked center column. Featured work occupies world-space as objects the camera approaches; HTML does not own a 12-column content well until later documentary sections.

typography.display: Large sans or slightly extended grotesque, often two-line statements that caption the scene rather than dominate it
typography.body: Smaller sans for credits, emails, project names; tracking modest; mixed case
typography.hierarchy: Scene first, word second. Display type rarely exceeds two short lines in the first viewport.

palette.ground: Dark desaturated stage so materials and bloom read
palette.accent: Comes from object materials and lights, not from a UI chip color

geometry: Rounded studio props, colliding primitives, and project-specific models sharing one gravity field. Avoids isolated hero torus. Objects have scale relationships between tiny UI and large world mass.
navigation: Minimal corner marks. Primary navigation is camera travel through the world plus a later project index.
hero: Camera already inside a lit volume. First action is environmental before any CTA. CTA if present is a small text link, not a filled pill.
motion: Physics-led entrance: objects drop or roll into rest. Camera eases between docks. Scroll maps to camera path more than to section fade.
interaction: Cursor exerts force or aim on nearby objects. Clicking a work object docks the camera instead of opening a modal over the scene.
imagery: Real-time 3D as primary image. Photographed work appears as texture or framed plane inside the world, not as CSS cards.
materials: PBR metals, rubber, painted studio floors, contact shadows, restrained bloom. Materials explain mass.
spatial_rhythm: Long beats of watching an object settle, then a camera truck to the next mass. Quiet after spectacle.
responsive: Desktop keeps physics world. Mobile collapses world to a single framed stage or baked poster plus reduced object count; type stacks under the stage.
signature_motif: A page whose layout is a physical set: gravity, collision, and camera docks instead of cards.
rejected_defaults: centered headline + subhead + dual CTA over a spinning primitive
permanent bloom + particles + magnetic buttons in one viewport
pure black ground with neon purple accent
project grid of identical 16:9 thumbnails as the first screen
